request.query: determinant evaluations of linear maps vanishes for linearly dependent vectors using scalar restriction

items.name: Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent_cols
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, (¬LinearIndependent R fun i => A.transpose i) → A.det = 0

items.name: Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent_rows
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, (¬LinearIndependent R fun i => A i) → A.det = 0

items.name: LinearMap.det_restrictScalars
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  [Module.Free R S] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup A] [inst_5 : Module R A] [inst_6 : Module S A] [inst_7 : IsScalarTower R S A]
  [Module.Free S A] {f : A →ₗ[S] A}, LinearMap.det (↑R f) = (Algebra.norm R) (LinearMap.det f)

items.name: LinearMap.det_eq_det_mul_det
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_6} {V : Type u_7} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] [Module.Finite R V]
  (W : Submodule R V) [Module.Free R ↥W] [Module.Finite R ↥W] [Module.Free R (V ⧸ W)] (e : V →ₗ[R] V)
  (he : W ≤ Submodule.comap e W), LinearMap.det e = LinearMap.det (e.restrict he) * LinearMap.det (W.mapQ W e he)

items.name: Matrix.gram_apply
items.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {𝕜 : Type u_4} [inst : Inner 𝕜 E] (v : n → E) (i j : n),
  Matrix.gram 𝕜 v i j = inner 𝕜 (v i) (v j)
